name: howto
title: Jump-start a car in six steps
sub: From the NOCO GB40 guide and the GOOLOO GP4000 manual; check your own pack's manual where it differs
footer: Sources: NOCO GB40 user guide (2021 copy); GOOLOO GP4000 manual; AAA. The step people skip is the light check.

items.head: Read the car manual
items.body: Some hybrids and EVs have a jump point; the 12-volt battery is what you jump.

items.head: Red to +, black to metal
items.body: Red clamp to positive, black to negative or a bare metal ground.

items.head: Plug in, lights off
items.body: Connect the clamps to the pack, turn off lights and radio.

items.head: Check the light
items.body: Ready light on, no red error light. A red light means the clamps are reversed.

items.head: Crank briefly
items.body: Rest 20 to 30 seconds between tries; NOCO allows five tries in 15 minutes.

items.head: Remove, recharge, test
items.body: Unplug the pack once the engine runs, recharge it, and get the car battery tested.
